about: UI patterns Leo killed. CI runs every checker (leo_bans.py, cmux-next-guards.yml job 'cmux-next Leo bans'); README.md says how to add one.

bans.description: Agent work shows the spinner, never a breathing, pulsing or blinking dot.
bans.quote: we need to guarantee the breathing dot doesnt come back
bans.quote_source: leo-asks log 68f592c680755fed, 2026-10-21T23:00:06Z; also a17cb83826047936 (21:02:40Z): "WE SAID NO … BLINKING … WE SAID … SPINNER"

checkers.why_grep: static-status-loops.test.ts still asserts the breathing default (#23870 rewrites it); this catches an infinite breathe, pulse or blink loop in any app stylesheet.
checkers.pending: https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux/pull/23870 (transcript default); the floating chat and Chief dock marks (acpmux/styles.css), Inspector subagent avatars (inspector.css), Apps skeleton and Channels ledger have no fix PR yet

bans.description: A sidebar workspace row never says Done (or any status word).
bans.quote: WHO BROUGHT BACK THE … DONE AND THE TIMERS
bans.quote_source: leo-asks log b16697a00da7f875, 2026-10-21T20:56:46Z; also 9178da360715339f (21:17:39Z): "MAKE SURE YOU … REMOVE THE DONE"

checkers.why_grep: the row is AppKit (WorkspaceRowView); its Swift tests run only on macOS, and SidebarRowStatusTests still expects Done until #23767.
must_catch: let trailingText = shown.chip.map { SidebarPriorityRowView.chipText($0, now: Date()) }

bans.description: A sidebar row shows no working-minutes or age timer ("4m", "1h 3m").
bans.quote: WHO BROUGHT BACK THE … DONE AND THE TIMERS

checkers.why_grep: the timer is AppKit (WorkspaceRowView+Elapsed.swift); WorkspaceRowElapsedTests asserts it until #23812 deletes it.

bans.description: No blue or system focus ring in the agent pane; focus is at most a hairline.
bans.quote: WTF IS THIS BLUE FOCUS RING CONSTANTLY APPEARING
bans.quote_source: leo-asks log 3b6b97d7340fca85, 2026-10-21T20:27:27Z; also 1bc45d9820333193 (20:28:29Z): "I … HATE THE APPEARANCE OF THIS FOCUS RING"

checkers.why_grep: the Swift side has no Linux-runnable test; the system accent colors are what draws a blue ring.
#23745's rendered test (agent-pane-hairline-focus.test.ts) needs Chromium; until it lands this catches a focus rule in the agent pane's stylesheets drawing an outline or shadow 1.5px or wider.

bans.description: Cards, menus, popovers and hover cards are glass, never a solid or opaque fill.
bans.quote: STOP DOING SOLID WE HAVE GLASS SO JUST … USE GLASS
bans.quote_source: leo-asks log 9178da360715339f, 2026-10-21T21:17:39Z; also 1bc45d9820333193 (20:28:29Z): "WHY … IS THIS SOLID COLOR AGAIN AND THE SIDEBAR HOVER PREVIEWS STILL BEING SOLID"

checkers.why_grep: the native overlay panel is AppKit (Glass.swift); FloatingSurfacesStayGlassTests runs only on macOS.

bans.description: The agent chat's scrollbar shows while there is something to scroll; it does not hide itself by default.
bans.quote: WHY DOES THE … SCROLLBAR IN THE CHAT AREA KEEP … HIDING ITSELF ON THE RIGHT … IT SHOULD … SHOW

checkers.why_grep: thin-scrollers.test.ts and check-scrollbars.sh still enforce hidden-at-rest (their rewrite belongs to the chat-load lane); this requires the transcript scroller to carry #23854's minimal-scroller attribute, which keeps the thumb while content overflows.
checkers.pending: no fix PR yet: #23854 gives the composer the minimal scroller; the transcript (.acpmux-scroll in App.tsx) still hides its thumb at rest

bans.description: An agent chat's pane does not ring, pulse or glow when a turn ends (default off; on, a neutral hairline).
bans.quote: no, I MEAN THE … MODEL RESPONSE DOES A DOUBLE BLUE RING PULSE
bans.quote_source: leo-asks log 19e1c05824036fb6, 2026-10-21T21:04:13Z; also afa0a225dcb436e9 (22:59:08Z): "i dont think we should have blinky on turn end for gui"

checkers.why_grep: AgentTurnRingTests runs only on macOS; this keeps the turn-end path behind the toggle.

bans.description: No "cmux manages compaction" row in the agent chat.
bans.quote: WHY THE … DOES IT SAY CMUX MANAGES COMPACTION!?

checkers.why_grep: the test covers SessionStartNote only; this keeps the words out of every web catalog.

bans.description: No "Steered · the agent read it" (or "Steering ·") caption under a steered message.
bans.quote: WTF IS THIS "THE AGENT READ IT" I THOUGHT WE REMOVED THAT

checkers.why_grep: #23763's rendered test (composer-plain-glyphs.test.ts) needs Chromium and WebKit; these custom properties are the disc's fill.
